fields.question: Which inbox items leave the list once their change set has landed, been withdrawn or rejected? The intent names failed runs only. A gave-up run's next command, rhiza run resume, is a dead end on such a change set too.

fields.question: Does a superseded change set also count as stale, alongside landed, withdrawn and rejected? Superseded is a terminal state the intent does not name, and a run on it can only be retried into a change set that has moved on.
fields.statement: Does a superseded change set also count as stale, alongside landed, withdrawn and rejected? Superseded is a terminal state the intent does not name, and a run on it can only be retried into a change set that has moved on. — Yes, stale (Recommended)
